note: Campground of the Kentucky Horse Park (a state agency, not the Kentucky State Parks system) north of Lexington, on wooded paved loops a short walk or shuttle ride from the park's museums and show grounds; open to all campers, not only horse-show exhibitors. Expect a long queue at the gate on evenings of the Southern Lights display (mid-November to December 31). Pool, tennis, basketball and dog park; work near the Loop B bathhouse had the courts and playground there closed in late 2026. --Claude
summary: Kept. 2025/2026 fees $35 (Nov-Mar) / $40-45 (Apr-Oct) / $50 holiday & event weekends, pull-through +$3 -> 35-53; extra person corrected to 5 included, $2 each, max 8. 257 paved Standard Electric sites (20/30/50A + water), 3 pull-throughs, 50-ft placeholder length; year-round (B and D loops only in winter). General campground, no horse sites. PIN ~0.95 km off (on Iron Works Pike) -> 38.1481,-84.5069.

HORSE RULE (passes): RA lists 257 sites, every one 'Standard Electric' with no horse/equestrian site type; the campground serves 'Kentucky Horse Park campground guests, horse show competitors, and park guests' (kyhorsepark.com FAQ, Wayback 2025-09-11) and show horses stable in the park's own barns (RA amenity list 'Horse Stalls' is the park facility). No page offers horse keeping at campsites. RV camping is general, not exhibitors-only: open year-round and sold by the night on ReserveAmerica.
